value.text: I am planning a weekend in Lisbon. Name one neighbourhood to stay in.

arguments.answer: Stay in Baixa/Chiado, Lisbon's central district. It's walkable to major sights, restaurants and nightlife, and it has excellent metro, tram and train connections, so it suits a short weekend. Alfama is a good alternative if you prefer a more historic, atmospheric feel.

value.name: final_answer
value.value: Stay in Baixa/Chiado, Lisbon's central district. It's walkable to major sights, restaurants and nightlife, and it has excellent metro, tram and train connections, so it suits a short weekend. Alfama is a good alternative if you prefer a more historic, atmospheric feel.

value.text: What is one dish I should try there?

arguments.answer: Try pastéis de nata, Lisbon's famous custard tarts, ideally warm from a bakery like Pastéis de Belém. If you want something savory, bacalhau à Brás (shredded salted cod with eggs and potatoes) is a classic local dish.
